name: Prescribing Pearls
tagline: The Art and Science of the Spectacle Prescription
description: A 15-episode series on spectacle prescribing — from the final Rx to lens materials, prism, tints, and the special prescriptions for computer, sports, and low vision.

episodes.title: Writing the Right Prescription: The Cylinder Axis Tolerance and the Vertex Compensation
episodes.description: The ANSI prescription tolerances, the axis and cylinder power tolerance, and the vertex distance compensation for high prescriptions.

episodes.title: Prescribing for Children: The Hyperopia Cut-Off, the Astigmatism, and the First Pair
episodes.description: The AAPOS prescribing guidelines for children, the cycloplegic vs manifest difference, and the first-pair counselling for parents.

episodes.title: Prescribing for the Presbyope: The Add, the Design, and the Working Distance
episodes.description: The add power selection by age and working distance, the PAL vs bifocal vs single vision choice, and the adaptation counselling.

episodes.title: Prescribing Prism: The Eye Deviation, the Fixation Disparity, and the Sheard Criterion
episodes.description: The prism calculation from the deviation, the fixation disparity and associated phoria, and the Sheard and Percival criteria for prescribing.

episodes.title: Translating Refraction to Glasses: The Trial Frame Verification and the Rx Check
episodes.description: The trial frame verification before prescribing, the over-refraction with the patient's current glasses, and the "is it time for a change" decision.

episodes.title: Progressive Addition Lenses: Fitting, Troubleshooting, and the Patient Adaptation
episodes.description: The PAL fitting (pupillary distance, fitting height), the corridor and the peripheral distortion, and the troubleshooting of the non-adapting patient.

episodes.title: Lens Materials and Index Selection: CR-39, Polycarbonate, Trivex, and High-Index
episodes.description: The lens material properties (index, Abbe, impact resistance), the material selection by prescription and use, and the cost-benefit.

episodes.title: Blue Light Filtering Lenses: The Evidence and the Patient Counselling
episodes.description: The blue light lens evidence (sleep, macula), the circadian and digital eye strain debate, and the honest patient counselling.

episodes.title: Sports and Safety Eyewear: The ASTM Standard and the Prescription Protection
episodes.description: The ASTM F803 sports eyewear standard, the prescription sports lens materials, and the safety eyewear for occupational and recreational use.

episodes.title: Sunglasses and UV Protection: The 400 nm Standard and the Polarised Lens
episodes.description: The UV (UVA, UVB) protection standard, the polarised vs tinted lens, and the prescription and the photochromic lens counselling.

episodes.title: Computer Glasses: The Working Distance, the Add, and the Blue Light Decision
episodes.description: The computer working distance measurement, the single vision vs PAL vs computer PAL choice, and the dry eye and ergonomics counselling.

episodes.title: Driving and Vision Standards: The Acuity, the Field, and the Legal Responsibility
episodes.description: The driving vision standards (acuity, field), the optometrist's legal responsibility, and the difficult driving cessation conversation.

episodes.title: Low Vision Prescribing: The High-Add, the Magnifier, and the Device Selection
episodes.description: The high-add single vision lens, the microscopic lens, the telescope, and the device selection algorithm for the low vision patient.

episodes.title: Tinted Lenses, Irlen, and Dyslexia: The Evidence vs the Anecdote
episodes.description: The evidence for tinted lenses in dyslexia and migraine, the Irlen syndrome controversy, and the honest evidence-based patient counselling.

episodes.title: The Art of Rx Changes: When to Change, When to Hold, and How to Counsel
episodes.description: The principles of changing (or not changing) a prescription, the small-change threshold, and the adaptation and the patient satisfaction.
